description.plain: Charge your devices lightning fast with the GravaStar USB-C 100w cable. With support PD 3.0 and QC 3.0 for up to 100W USB-C Power Delivery adapters and data transfer speeds of up to 480Mbps, this 1.5m long cable is also durable, thanks to its black TPE layer. Upgrade your charging experience today!

media.alt_text: Coiled black GravaStar 1.5m USB-C to USB-C 100W charging cable with branded connectors.

unique_selling_points: Supports both PD 3.0 and QC 3.0 for versatile, high-speed charging up to 100W.
top_features: Supports PD 3.0 and QC 3.0 standards for compatibility with a wide range of devices
Delivers up to 100W USB C power for rapid charging of high-drain devices
Enables data transfer speeds up to 480Mbps for efficient file transfers
Durable TPE layer enhances cable longevity and resistance to wear
1.5m length provides flexible, extended reach for convenient charging
